messages:
alex: CI alert from perf-smoke: release-candidate-123 shows 2.7x tail P99 for small-seq workloads. spotted in the nightly perf job around 02:10 UTC. stack: runtime/gpu kernel selection path + batching. logs attached below.

alex: excerpt from job:
```
[2026-03-18T02:09:58Z] perf-smoke: p99 latency 320ms (baseline 120ms)
[2026-03-18T02:09:58Z] runtime: chosen kernel = attention_fused_v2_width24
[2026-03-18T02:09:58Z] batcher: effective_batch_timeout_ms=12 -> 28
[2026-03-18T02:09:58Z] kvcache: miss_rate=0.18 (baseline 0.02)
```

alex: marking as release-blocker, tagging @maria @jin for bisect. :eyes:

maria: ack. I can take the bisect. which branch is the candidate?

alex: release/v1.23-rc -> build id rc-20260318-7. regression appears between rc-5 and rc-6.

maria: starting git bisect now. will run perf harness locally on the bench rig (p4d-like). will post commit range.

maria: git-bisect found first bad commit: 7c9a2d4 — "batcher: increase default batch window to favor throughput". also kernel selector change in 8a2b1f1 "kernel: prefer width24 for short sequences" appears in same window.

maria: repro steps (on bench): `./perf-run --scenario small-seq --reps 50 --model redwood/open-small` -> see p99 jump on commits >= 7c9a2d4

jin: that matches my profiling from last week. batching window bump increases time-to-dispatch for tiny requests; combined with width24 kernel the per-token latency increases due to wider kernel internal tiling for short N. kv miss spike is weird though.

sam: could kv cache regression be independent? I saw a recent eviction threshold change in 9f1dbe0 (kv: lower in-memory slot count). maybe combined effect causes more cold starts which don't benefit from small batch merging.

ci-bot: [job perf-smoke/rc-20260318-7] failed: p99 > threshold. https://ci.internal/jobs/12345

maria: proposed mitigation path: 1) create hotfix branch from release/v1.23-rc 2) cherry-pick revert of 7c9a2d4 (batch window) 3) cherry-pick kv slot fix from main if 9f1dbe0 is the culprit OR revert kernel selector override 8a2b1f1 4) run perf verification on dedicated perf infra 5) if green, cut hotfix release.

jin: prefer not to revert kernel selector globally — that reg changed for other benefit. better to revert batch-window and patch kv eviction (increase slots) for release branch. that should restore tail.

natalie: we need to check whether reverting batch-window breaks throughput SLO for long-seq workloads. can we run quick load test as part of verification?

maria: yes. verification plan:
- perf-smoke small-seq p99 / 50 reps
- throughput-long-seq latency & tokens/sec 10m run
- check kv miss rates and kernel choices (`grep chosen kernel` in logs)
- attach flamegraph from `perf-map` to confirm kernel time contribution

sam: I'll prep the hotfix branch and do the cherry-picks. planning branch name `release/v1.23-hotfix/batch-kv`

release-bot: created branch `release/v1.23-hotfix/batch-kv` from release/v1.23-rc at commit af3d11e. PR templates: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pulls/new

sam: cherry-picked reverts: `git cherry-pick -x 7c9a2d4` (batch-window) and `git cherry-pick -x a7b4f9c` (kv-slot bump from main). pushed + opened PR #487. inviting @maria @jin for review.

maria: running perf harness on perf-rig-2 with branch head. command: `./perf-run --branch release/v1.23-hotfix/batch-kv --scenario small-seq --reps 50`

[~15m later]

maria: initial results: p99 down to 130ms (baseline 120ms) — much better. kv miss_rate back to 0.03. chosen kernel now `attention_fused_v1_width16` for short sequences.

jin: nice. can you also run long-seq throughput check?

maria: long-seq 10m: tokens/sec within 97% of RC baseline, latency tail unchanged. flamegraph shows less time in kernel selection path.

alex: great. any CI flakes?

ci-bot: running perf-smoke/replica on release-hotfix PR #487 - queued on dedicated perf runners.

[~20m later]

ci-bot: perf-smoke/replica PASSED. p99 within threshold.

sam: merging PR to hotfix branch and tagging for release. will coordinate release pipeline.

natalie: notify support and release channels. this was a blocker for RC -> GA.

alex: action items: 
- sam: cut hotfix and start rollout (staged canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- jin: follow-up PR to main to adjust kernel selector heuristics to avoid short-seq regressions (don't disable width16 fallback)
- maria: add perf tests to CI to cover small-seq p99 with both kernel variants
- ops: monitor tail latency during rollout, set auto-fallback if p99 exceeds threshold.

sam: rolling out canary now (env `KERNEL_SELECTION=legacy-fallback` for canary) — will watch dashboards. :shipit: 

alex: thanks everyone. leaving the thread open for final post-rollout confirmation.

maria: post-rollout check at +1h: canary -> 10% -> 50% all green. p99 stable. closing as resolved. :thumbsup:

alex: resolving and adding notes to release log: revert-batch-window + kv-slot bump hotfix cut, follow-up kernel-selector PR queued.
